# Phase Two — Improved Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos creates every route in its moment; Awtsmoos.com should improve by a rhythm that is broad in scope and exact in evidence.

## Work Graph

Census → classify public vs fixture → audit live routes → merge runtime findings with active ownership → rank → repair clean family → reread → tests → browser → performance → rerun full audit → next family.

## Evidence Ledger Fields

Route, source entry, family, owner/claim, current Git status, load status, console errors, failed resources, overflow, focus/labels/touch findings, visual hierarchy notes, performance timings, planned files, actual files, tests, browser proof, remaining delta.

## Mutation Doctrine

- Full-file rewrites only.
- Split any touched source >120 lines rather than compressing.
- Tabs in indented touched source.
- Preserve/expand comments rather than deleting them for line count.
- No global stylesheet changes until repeated root-cause evidence exists.
- No minified repository source.

## Verification Rhythm

Family-level focused tests first; live browser second; performance third; sitewide regression rerun fourth. A route is not complete until all relevant gates pass.

## Performance Rhythm

Cold navigation, warm navigation, request/transfer inventory, blocking resources, long tasks/interactive readiness, cache headers/content encoding, compact-vs-normal benchmark where supported.

## Release Rhythm

Secret scan → large/generated review → fetch/topology → full safe staging → commit → refresh concurrent delta → follow-up commit if needed → push → verify remote SHA → actual deploy → production smoke → production performance → final delta push.

## NEXT_ACTION

Perform the Phase Three critique, freeze the exact next execution tranche, then harvest running tests/census/audit jobs and begin route ranking.
